title: Water wing (SPLIT-SAME) — the drowned gallery and the grotto
fingerprintMethod: sha256 over canonical JSON (object keys sorted recursively) of the entry in RAW_MUSEUM_SEQUENCES.

claims.statement: Water stages the exact museum sequences AAAA, BBBB and CCCC (cave-water-seq-a/b/c), five-step alpha1-to-alpha1 loops. Re-fingerprinted 2026-08-12 after commit 8476f35c2e re-transcribed all 19 wing sequences verbatim from the catalog and moved these three off alpha3.
A, B and C are the Split-Same group of Type 1 Dual-Shift: A blue pro/red pro, B anti/anti, C blue anti/red pro.
evidence: Flow Arts MCP get_letter_explanation C, 2026-08-12: Type 1 Dual-Shift, blue anti / red pro, Split-Same group is ABC = pro + anti + hybrid

claims.statement: Every dimension on the Gate 1 board is read out of the compiled room geometry, not drawn by eye.
Still water you cannot cross stands in for a display case: the three performers are visible and unreachable.
The mirror pool doubling each performer, and the wing's shared move being shown once on the opener before you meet three versions of it.
The parapet deck, the opener plinth and dais, three wall screens and three rail cards. None exist in the geometry yet; the Gate 1 board is the proposal for all of them.

supersededClaims.note: The three-channels direction was rejected on 2026-08-11. Its air-bell audiences, buoyant water shaft, channel-length letter ordering and firelit channel mouths are retired with it.
statements: Channel length encodes letter order: A shortest, C (the hybrid) longest.
Private air-bell audiences: surfacing and meeting a letter are the same moment.
A reduced-gravity buoyant water shaft carries the player up to the grotto ring after the dives.
Each channel mouth glows with its bell's firelight color through the water.

evidence.note: Sheets P-01 (whole walk, 1 grid = 5 m) and P-02 (the grotto at 1 grid = 1 m) with entry, exit, doors, blocked rects, performer shelf, opener and parapet.
Sheet S-01: floor line, eye line at 1.6 m, water surfaces at -1.5 m and -0.45 m, rock roof at -1.9 m, submerged span measured at 28.4 m of 124.9 m.
Thirteen numbered stops with chainage, what the visitor sees and what they understand at each.
Sheet P-02 sightlines from the parapet stand at (20.25, 15.0): A 16.6 m at -53 deg, B 11.8 m at -32 deg, C 10.0 m at +4.3 deg, 57.2 deg total spread, with reflection bounce points.

checks.name: walkability
checks.evidence: Route sampled every 0.2 m against createDrownedGalleryTerrain blockedAt/elevationAt. No sample lands on shore, channel, pool, rock fill or a threshold jamb. Parapet deck is the one exception and is recorded as decision W-2: it sits inside the single blocked pool rect, which must be split into three when the deck is built.

checks.name: clearance
checks.evidence: Eye at 1.6 m over the floor clears the gallery rock roof at -1.9 m throughout the submerged leg; grotto ceiling is 9.5 m over the deck. Landing at -3.1 m is derived so the eye sits exactly on the -1.5 m waterline.

checks.name: sightlines
checks.evidence: All three cases visible from the parapet stand with a receding 57.2 deg spread; all three reflection bounce points computed at z = 9.17, inside the channel span 6.25 to 10.25, so each performer's double lands on water rather than deck.

checks.name: final-view
checks.evidence: Parapet in the northeast corner of the grotto is the last stop before the Fire door. Reached by walking the procession west to east past A, B and C with no backtracking; A reads smallest from there, so the three cases stack in walk order.
